0022600111.text: The Phoenix Suns (0-1, 15th in the West) host the Golden State Warriors (0-2, 13th in the West) in the Suns' second game of the season, with Phoenix 1.5 games back of the Pacific lead and Golden State 2 games back in third. Mark Williams is out for Phoenix with shoulder surgery, while Luke Kennard (knee strain) and Oso Ighodaro (oblique strain) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. For Golden State, Brandin Podziemski (back), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Stephen Curry (rest) are out, and Charles Bassey (knee) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after the Suns lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 101-97 loss in Phoenix on February 5, 2026.
